title: Emirates vs. Italy, Lufthansa's Airline Collection Grows, and JetBlue's Bag Fees Just Won't Quit
summary: ITA Airways is racing Emirates to launch a route neither of them really needs to fly yet, Lufthansa makes it official on a billion-dollar stake in TAP Air Portugal, and six airlines just found out they've been sitting in a data breach for three years. Plus, Boeing's 787 gets a lightning-strike warning, and JetBlue hikes bag fees for the second time this year.
